places.text: Game that comes to you: in the dry season everything in the park is at one of the waterholes.
places.title: Etosha

places.text: Two thousand rock engravings on one hillside, cut into sandstone six thousand years ago.
places.title: Twyfelfontein

places.title: Kolmanskop and the Coast

places.text: The best self-drive country in Africa: gravel roads, long distances and nobody on them.
places.title: Self-Drive Country

image.alt: the dune field of the Namib at first light, Namibia

places.text: Fifty-five million years old, and dunes at Sossusvlei three hundred metres high.
places.title: The Namib

places.title: Epupa

places.text: Fifteen hundred kilometres of Atlantic, fog, shipwrecks and seal colonies.
places.title: The Skeleton Coast

places.text: No rainforest — the green is in the Zambezi region, riverine and full of elephant.
places.title: The Caprivi Woodland

places.text: Owambo, Herero, Damara, Nama, San and more, and German still on half the street signs.
places.title: Eleven Peoples

places.text: The Himba of the Kunene, whose way of life is genuinely intact and should be visited carefully.
places.title: The Himba

places.text: Game meat over coals, biltong on every counter, and German bread that is actually German.
places.title: Braai and Biltong

places.title: Windhoek Karnival and Maherero Day

places.text: Kavango wood carving, San ostrich-eggshell beadwork, and Herero doll making.
places.title: Basketry and Ostrich Shell

places.title: Windhoek and Swakopmund

places.title: Colonial and Desert Vernacular

places.text: Fuel, biltong and a farm stall every two hundred kilometres, and that is the day.

places.title: Dune, Quad, Balloon

places.title: Desert Camps

places.title: Conservancies

places.title: The Cleanest Light in Africa
